description: This file defines the 'FrontPanelIndicator' class and nested classes 'Color' and 'Blink', along with their members, involved in managing front panel indicator settings such as color, brightness, blink sequences, and related properties. It includes several constant definitions, member functions, and class relationships, indicating it's a header for a device settings component in a C++ project.

classes.name: device::FrontPanelIndicator
classes.description: Manage front panel indicators' color, blink sequence, brightness, and state, following DSConstant settings with singleton access.

classes.name: device::FrontPanelIndicator::Color
classes.description: Represent predefined colors for front panel indicators, extending DSConstant, providing static instances for common colors.

classes.name: device::FrontPanelIndicator::Blink
classes.description: Handle blink sequence parameters including interval and iteration for front panel indicators.
